description: This file defines a React functional component 'PredicateValue' which renders different form inputs based on the type of predicate keypath. It manages user input for various data types such as 'noteType', 'editorIdentifier', 'string', 'date', 'boolean', and 'number'. The component connects to application context and uses external utility functions for dropdown items.
